Exercise four. Your thermometer has been withdrawn. You have been issued an altimeter. Press 1 to hold it up and wait for the needle to settle. Then show the contours on your map and guess somewhere at the same height. Each contour line is ten metres apart. You are standing on one. Please try not to fall off it.
